lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/dialogs: 386,118 B in 9 modules on the notes-main page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 5,132 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
css holds 2 stylesheets, 2,173 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
1,143 B in 8 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
110 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
